class florica.nomen.app.MainWindowController(view)¶

The controller class of the MainWindow class Initializes the MainWindowController object given a view object. It sets the view, window, connected status, db properties, authors delegate, config manager, and loads widgets from and to the view. It sets the filtering and sorting on the proxy model for trview_taxonref, creates the metadata worker (Qthread) and sets the slots signals.

class florica.core.database.DatabaseConnection¶

A class for managing connections to a PostgreSQL database. It configures the standard methods for opening, closing, and executing connections using a pg_connexion dictionary containing parameters (host, username, password, database, port). It checks for the existence of the schema and executes the scripts necessary to create the database if required.

check_schema_and_tables()¶

DBASE: Checks if the schema and specific tables exist in the database. If not, create them with SQL scripts

close()¶

DBASE: Close the current database connection

dbname()¶

DBASE: Returns the name of the current database if it’s open, otherwise None

exec(sql)¶

DBASE: Execute the provided SQL query and returns the result

last_error()¶

DBASE: Returns the last error that occurred in the database connection

open(pg_connexion)¶

DBASE: Open a connection to a PostgreSQL database using a pg_connexion dictionary

postgres_error()¶

DBASE: Converts the last error in the database connection into a text string

class florica.models.taxa_model.PNTaxa_searchAPI(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)¶

Worker thread to query multiple biodiversity APIs asynchronously.

Emits:
Result_Signal (str, object): Signal emitted with API name and data dictionary

or special status strings like “END” or “NOTCONNECTED”.

Args:

parent (QObject): Parent QObject for the thread. myPNTaxa (object, optional): Model or taxon object to query. Defaults to None. filter (str, optional): Limits queries to a single API from the supported list. Defaults to None.

Attributes:

PNTaxa_model (object): The taxon model to query. status (int): Thread status flag, 1 for running, 0 for stopped. list_api (list): List of API names to query.

Result_Signal¶

alias of str

kill()¶

Signal to stop the thread’s operation and emit an “END” signal.

run()¶

Main thread loop that queries each API in the list sequentially.

Steps:

  • Checks for internet connectivity.

  • Iterates over the APIs to query metadata and synonyms.

  • Emits results through Result_Signal.

  • Stops if status is set to 0.

class florica.models.taxa_model.PN_TaxaSearch(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any)¶

The PN_TaxaSearch class is a custom class that inherits from QtWidgets.QWidget. It is designed to display a search widget composed of a search text and a treeview result with matched taxa and score.

Signals:

selectionChanged (str): Emitted when the selection in the treeview changes. doubleClicked (object): Emitted when an item in the treeview is double-clicked.
